sentences.en: Without the error, our team could have won the game.
sentences.zh: 如果没有那个错误，我们队本可以赢得比赛。

sentences.en: I had my brother correct the errors in my composition.
sentences.zh: 我让哥哥帮我修改作文中的错误。

sentences.en: There's a certain pleasure in pointing out other people's errors.
sentences.zh: 指出别人的错误有一种特殊的乐趣。
